title: Remove unreachable pending-audit resume branch after named-root release replay lookup
outcome: Named-root release has a single reachable selection-matching replay path; remove the strict-subset pending-audit lookup that cannot be reached after the earlier all-audits lookup returns, and put its explanatory comment on the actual replay path without changing release semantics.
acceptance: Remove unreachable pending-audit resume branch after named-root release replay lookup is done
